scope: Outcome-free comparison of the identical frozen selection in two archived mixed-book CBS displays. Quote-implied break-even describes the price including vig, not model probability or estimated edge. Win-profit differences use a hypothetical $5 stake and assume a win only for payout comparison. Changed lines affect win and push conditions. Price and line direction are both retained; cross-source display changes do not establish sportsbook-specific movement or closing-line value. No wagers, eligibility changes, or rule promotion.
